notes: Piece counts match the 175-piece parts list for every type and colour.

Three separate groups is correct for this set. The booklet builds three free-standing models: the fire station (b1-b150, including the pyramid roof, hydrant and lights), the fire truck (b151-b165) and the helicopter (b166-b175). The truck and helicopter are never attached to the station or to each other. Page 26 and the cover show the truck parked beside the station and the helicopter hovering above it. I kept them separate and added no joins, because the manual makes none.
The booklet gives no coordinates and many pieces are small, so rests_on is my best reading of the pictures. Exact stud overlaps in the layered walls, roof and tower are approximate.
In the booklet the 1x1 and 1x2 plate stacks are shown in white-ish or clear icons. I counted them as Trans-Clear with White tops, so that the White and Trans-Clear totals match the parts list.
The two 4081b (clip) pieces are shown as wheel holders on the fire truck. I recorded the four black 1x1 round plates as wheels pressed into them, two per holder.
The pyramid roof (booklet pages 19-21, step 28) is built separately and then sits on the four white cones. Its two outer white 1x3 plates therefore rest on the cones, which ties it into the station.
The blue pin in the helicopter is pushed into the underside of the white 4733 brick after the model is turned over. The black 1x3 plates then sit on the pin.
Both black technic pins are in the right-hand red technic brick, as the two cannon pins. The left technic brick is left empty.
The yellow cone, the white cones and the other cone-type pieces sit on studs of round plates. The cones have no studs of their own.
